title: Personal Training Packages: deciding an archived package's closed date
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the lapse-forfeiture status and the established-membership requirement together decide the closed date recorded when a package is archived.

## Rule
The package is archived with its closed date backdated to its own expiration date, rather than to the day archiving staff act, only where both hold together: the package's expiration forfeiture is already on record, and the member's own club membership is established as described in the established-membership requirement. Where either of those two does not hold, the package is archived with its closed date set to the day archiving staff act, which is the current date.

## Points of judgement
Both conditions must hold together for the backdating courtesy to apply; neither is sufficient on its own. A package whose expiration forfeiture is already on record, but whose member holds no established membership, is archived with today's date rather than a backdated one. A package whose member holds an established membership, but whose expiration forfeiture is not yet on record (because the package's status is exhausted rather than expired), is likewise archived with today's date rather than a backdated one.
